svg.aria-label: The pipeline: inside MongoDB Atlas, scheduled Trigger 1 runs every minute and inserts a new document into the Atlas cluster with insertOne. Scheduled Trigger 2 also runs every minute and sends an aggregate to the federated database instance, which reads the last 60 seconds of documents from the cluster. Its $out stage writes them as Parquet to events.parquet in an Amazon S3 bucket, replacing the file on every run.
